acceptance_predicates.description: Every supported row binds an immutable catalog source revision and digest to one declared adapter and package/install strategy; unknown strategies fail closed.
Adapters materialize only a bounded project-local dependency/runtime closure with finite argument arrays and no runtime downloads or unbounded installers.

Launcher and entrypoint identity, regular-file or approved symlink target, executable mode and runtime compatibility are verified before activation; missing, substituted, archive-only or mismatched outputs fail closed.
The explicit per-tool support matrix has deterministic offline positive fixtures and typed unsupported rows for tools without a safe adapter.

Bounded content-minimized receipts bind source, adapter, closure, entrypoint, smoke, rollback and retention facts; failed attempts leave no false usable state and retain the last known-good installation.

Negative fixtures prove rejection of unknown strategies, archive outputs without adapters, missing entrypoints, runtime mismatch, unbounded installers and runtime downloads before process or state effects.

definition_of_done: The source-to-executable adapter/runtime contract and explicit per-tool support matrix are implemented against current main.
Independent review, exact-head CI, signed protected merge, exact-main post-merge qualification and durable acceptance evidence pass.

inputs.description: AR-1776 immutable supported-tool acquisition catalog and verification identities.

outputs.description: Verified per-tool adapter/runtime contract, support matrix, offline fixtures and bounded receipts.

gates.description: Credential-free offline fixtures cover every supported matrix row and explicitly classify unsupported rows.
All required hostile source, entrypoint, runtime and installer cases fail closed before process or usable-state effects.
Positive activation and failed-attempt rollback/retention receipts are bounded, digest-bound and deterministic.
